jobs_results.title: JAVA DEVELOPER WITH DEVOPS SKILLS
jobs_results.description:
JAVA DEVELOPER WITH DEVOPS SKILLS

Desde Capgemini Engineering queremos incorporar a nuestro equipo un/a Desarrollador/a Java con Devops Skills que quiera seguir creciendo profesionalmente en una Empresa Familiarmente Responsable y Top Employer.

Requisitos
• Experiencia de al menos 1 año desarrollando Java con Spring boot.
• Experiencia con Docker y Kubernetes.
• Conocimientos de configuración de pipelines en Git.
• Nivel de inglés alto (B2-C1)

Funciones

La persona que se incorpore se encargará del:
• Desarrollo de nuevos componentes en Java.
• Manejo de Kubernetes y containers (despliegue de pods, services, ingress, portforwarding, configuración de .yaml)
• Manejo de Helm chart para test y creación de paquetes (configuración de .yaml).
• Testing en Cucumber (Typescript y Java).

Se ofrece
• Contrato Indefinido
• Seguro de vida y accidentes
• Tickets restaurante
• Tickest guardería
• Sistema de compra de días de vacaciones adicionales.
• Retribución flexible (seguro médico... guardería, transporte, formación).
• Flexibilidad horaria, nos importa la conciliación y que tengas un equipo entre la vida personal y profesional.
• Posibilidad de teletrabajar.
• Formación continua, podrás disfrutar de Mylearning y de Capgemini University con acceso a plataformas como: Coursera, Udemy, Pluralsight, harvard Manager Mentor, entre otros.
• Formación en idiomas con acceso a cursos de Inglés, Francés y Alemán.

Nuestro compromiso con la inclusión e igualdad de oportunidades hace que tengamos un Plan de Igualdad y un Código Ético que garantizan el desarrollo profesional de la plantilla y la igualdad de oportunidades en su selección dentro de un entono libre de discriminación por cuestión de etnia, nacionalidad, origen social, edad, orientación sexual, expresión de género, religión o cualquier otra circunstancia personal, física o social.

En Capgemini Engineering valoramos todas las candidaturas, aunque no tengas el 100% de los conocimientos, ¡no dudes en inscribirte

jobs_results.title: Senior DevOps Engineer
jobs_results.description:
This a Full Remote job, the offer is available from: Spain

Department: Infrastructure **

Employment Type: Full Time

Location: Remote

Reporting To: Nikita Lishin

Description**

We are looking for a DevOps Engineer to help us with an outstanding runtime and development platform for Tabby’s services. **

Our tech stack:**

Linux, kubernetes, GCP (GKE, Pub/Sub, Cloud PostgreSQL, Spanner), Datadog, Gitlab, Cloudflare, Elasticsearch, Terragrunt, Istio, Vault, ArgoCD, Helm, Go

Key Responsibilities
• Design scalable and reliable cloud infrastructure
• Create a cloud platform suitable for running software services
• Automate infrastructure provisioning
• Ensure the smooth operation of and participate in emergency response situations for outages in our infrastructure
• Security hardening (PCI-DSS)
• Observability and monitoring improvement

Skills, Knowledge and Expertise
• 3+ years of experience as DevOps engineer
• Experience with Kubernetes and Service Mesh solutions (istio)
• Familiar... with observability tooling
• Public cloud knowledge, GCP would be a bonus skill
• Experience with investigating issues in production
• Experience with DevOps best practices, including security, CI/CD, monitoring, and alerting
• Basic development skills
• Network knowledge, TCP/IP knowledge, REST API, GRPC

This offer from "Tabby" has been enriched by Jobgether.com and got a 72% flex score

jobs_results.title: DevOps Engineer
jobs_results.description:
You will join a world class technical team with state of the art expertise in developing and delivering advanced decentralized applications (Dapps). This role will be to define and manage all aspects of the development and production infrastructure as part of an agile scrum team working on Enterprise client projects.

Responsibilities include:

● Build and run production infrastructure

● Implement and support CI/CD pipelines

● Setup monitoring and tracking tools to support developer teams

On a daily basis you will be part of an agile, often multinational scrum team delivering high standard production software. You will work closely with the project team composed of a project manager, back-end and front-end developers, QA Engineers, Customer Success teams, and the project stakeholders.

What tools will you use:

We work with infrastructure as code tools (e.g. Pulumi, terraform), containers and container orchestration (e.g. Kubernetes, ECS); event source / message based architectures... (e.g. Kafka); Amazon Web Services (AWS); both RDBMS and NoSQL Datastores (e.g. Postgres, Mongo, Redis, DynamoDb); Linux based operating systems; and of course blockchain and DLT. Understanding both traditional virtual server infrastructure, containerized workloads, as well as modern serverless workloads is a key part of the expertise we are looking for.

Bloomays focuses on Blockchains and Blockchain / Cryptocurrency. Their company has offices in Spain, France, Romania, Italy, and Hungary. They have a mid-size team that's between 51-200 employees.

You can view their website at https://www.bloomays.com

DevOps Engineer (m / w / d) Digital Health

MEDIAN Unternehmenszentrale Berlin

MEDIAN is one of Europe's leadingproviders of medical rehabilitation and mental health services.With more than 120 rehabilitation centres throughout Germany,MEDIAN offers a dynamic and innovative environment for employees ina wide range of areas with a variety of job opportunities anddevelopment opportunities for applicants.

Specialising inrehabilitation and participation, we accompany our patients on theroad to recovery and back into society - in line with our guidingprinciple of "Living life".

We are looking assoon as possible for a DevOps Engineer (m / w / d) Digital Health.

Your main tasks
• Build, manage and maintain a self-hosted... Kubernetesecosystem for our services
• Lead thedevelopment and implementation of Infrastructure as Code solutionsusing tools like Terraform, Ansible, or CloudFormation to automatethe provisioning of infrastructure
• Establishrobust monitoring, alerting, and log management systems toproactively identify and resolve issues, ensuring high availabilityand performance
• Implement security bestpractices across the infrastructure, applications, and deploymentprocesses, including vulnerability assessments and compliancechecks
• Collaborate with cross-functionalteams, including developers and system administrators, to ensureseamless integration of DevOps practices into the softwaredevelopment lifecycle

Yourprofile
• Several years ofexperience in a DevOps or Site Reliability Engineering role,demonstrating a strong background in infrastructure and deploymentautomation
• Proficiency in Infrastructure asCode (IaC) tools such as Terraform, Ansible, or CloudFormation
• Expertise in setting up and managing CI / CDpipelines, using tools like Jenkins, GitLab CI, or CircleCI
• In-depth knowledge of containerizationtechnologies (Docker) and container orchestration systems(Kubernetes) and their related technologies (Docker Compose,Istio / Linkerd, Cert-Manager, etc.)
• Experience with on-premise / self-hosting
• Thorough understanding of security best practices and experienceimplementing security measures within DevOps processes
• Familiarity with monitoring and alerting tools (e.g.,Prometheus, Grafana, ELK stack)
• Familiaritywith tracing tools (e.g., Jaeger, Zipkin, OpenTelemetry)
• Strong problem-solving skills and theability to troubleshoot complex issues
• Excellent communication and collaboration skills

We offer you the following benefits
• Opportunity to develop onedigital health solution from scratch and bring another to the nextlevel
• 200.000+ own patients per year waitingfor our digital health solutions
• Medicaldoctors, psychologist and therapists in 125+ MEDIAN clinicsproviding expert input
• Flat hierarchies withdirect access to MEDIAN’s top management

jobs_results.title: DevOps / SysAdmin
jobs_results.description:
About YEGO

Today, Urban mobility is one of the most dynamic and strategic sectors, as our cities continue to grow, air and noise pollution levels soar and public space shrinks. Responses to these challenges are therefore increasingly urgent and complex.

The main challenge is to propose efficient alternatives to the private car while at the same time providing innovative solutions aimed at protecting public space so that everyone can find their place and enjoy it in complete safety. The different micro-mobility solutions contribute to building a dynamic, modern, ecological, multimodal and noise-free urban environment.

YEGO was born in 2016, when shared mobility as a light vehicle was still in an experimental phase, with the mission to facilitate and rethink access to ecological and responsible micro-mobility, in harmony with cities and their inhabitants, offering an ecological and elegant shared motorbike service for everyone.

In 6 years we have already converted more than 10... million daily journeys into unique experiences in 7 European cities and metropolitan areas in Spain and France: Barcelona, Valencia, Seville, Malaga, Bordeaux, Paris, Toulouse, and in a few weeks Nice. With a strategy of progressive development, constant and controlled growth and a solid economic and financial model, our company is today one of the most experienced in the European market. Innovation, quality, safety and attention to local needs are values anchored in YEGO since the launch of the service.

Since 2022, YEGO has been officially recognised in France as a "société à mission", i.e. a company with a purpose. Our raison d'être, formalized in our statutes, is to work for the provision of an urban electric transport service that is sustainable, safe, adapted to all publics and respectful of the environment and users. Around this project, we are building a united, dynamic, diverse, inclusive and committed team in which everyone, regardless of origin, gender, religion, orientation, age or ability, can thrive and serve our mission to make our cities healthier.

Mission

Manage and optimize the infrastructure and automate processes to ensure efficient deployment of systems and maintain a high level of service availability.

Key Responsibilities
• Implement and maintain Kubernetes clusters for containerized applications in high-availability context
• Set up and monitor dashboards, analyze problems and implement solutions to ensure optimum availability and performance.
• Optimize data backup and restoration processes. Apply good security practices against internal or external threats and carry out regular audits to ensure compliance.
• Design, develop and implement automation tools and processes to optimize systems development, testing and deployment operations.
• Hands-on experience in analyzing and improving the efficiency, scalability of data collection, storage, and retrieval processes
• Stay up-to-date with industry trends, emerging technologies, and best practices in data engineering and DevOps to drive innovation and continuous improvement.
• Maintain detailed documentation of data engineering processes, infrastructures, and troubleshooting

Required Qualifications
• Experience with orchestration/containerisation via Kubernetes and Docker.
• Experience with microservices and distributed / scalable platforms
• Experience with data storage and processing technologies (e.g. Hadoop, Spark, Kafka, SQL databases, NoSQL databases)
• Experience in setting up Continuous Integration / Continuous Deployment processes (GitLab or GitHub actions)

Tech Stacks
• AWS EC2, RDS, EKS, Route 53, Lambda
• Docker and Kubernetes
• MySQL, Redis, Redshift, Athena, Meilisearch, Influx
• Grafana, Prometheus/CloudWatch
• Terraform, Packer, Ansible

Perks
• The opportunity to participate in an innovative project, dedicated to changing mobility into a unique environmentally friendly experience.
• Working with a young and passionate team, towards the same goals.
• A modern workspace in Poblenou.
• Free fruit, snacks, coffee and tea at the office.
• Gym membership discount (Andjoy).
• Unlimited use of YEGO electric motorbikes.
• Health insurance (CIGNA)
• Flexible retribution plan (Cobee)
• Flexible working hours and the possibility to work remotely.

YEGO is proud of being an equal-opportunity workplace. We celebrate diversity and we are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees regardless of background, gender, religion, orientation, age, or ability

jobs_results.title: Lead DevOps
DevOps Engineer
jobs_results.description:
We are seeking an experienced Dev Ops Engineer to start immediately. This would be a full-time on-site position at our office in Barcelona. The same position in Madrid office is also available.

The job requires the following responsabilities:
• Leading test and integration efforts with regards to deploying mission critical software.
• Developing new ways of automation and continuous delivery.
• Taking ownership of technical issues, and working with our Development group to resolve more advanced issues when necessary.
• Resolving escalated customer complaints.
• Documenting troubleshooting and problem resolution steps.

Qualifications
• Bachelor’s or Master’s Degree in Computer Science / Engineering or related field.
• Have exceptional troubleshooting and customer-handling skills.
• Show excellent communication in English (both verbal and written).
• Proven experience working with distributed Linux operating systems (installation, configuration and troubleshooting).
• Understanding of... Linux core fundamentals, command-line operations, scripting and service monitoring.
• Solid understanding of IP networking and network devices.
• Experience with Kernel and network based tuning for performance and stability.
• Experience with automation and configuration management using provisioning tools like Ansible.
• Strong support and/or administration experience for enterprise software solutions.
• Good scripting skills (awk, sed, bash).
• Understanding of one or more programming languages such as Java, Python, or C++.
• Firm understanding of version control systems such as subversion.
• Solid understanding of agilie methodologies, working in small teams, Continuous Integration and Continuous Delivery

jobs_results.title: DevOps & Infrastructure Admin
jobs_results.description:
Description

About Apex ESG Advantage

Our current economic system has brought unprecedented levels of welfare and prosperity. Yet, in many ways, this has come at a great environmental and societal cost. The time has come to forge a new path, and to transition to a more sustainable economy.

Apex ESG Advantage is one of the fastest growing ESG and sustainability firms in Europe, experiencing solid growth over the past 24 months. Our team consists of approximately 150 people from various backgrounds across Amsterdam, London, New York, Valencia and Mumbai all driven by the ambition to make a real impact.

Launched in 2021, Apex ESG Advantage is a business-to-business (b2b) software as a Service (SaaS) platform that allows companies to track their ESG performance and benchmark it against their peers and industry best practices. Specifically designed for the private equity market, it provides investors and fund managers with a holistic overview of the performance of their portfolio... companies.

The role

As a DevOps and Infrastructure Administrator, you will play a pivotal role in designing, implementing, and maintaining our cloud-based infrastructure, while ensuring seamless CI/CD pipelines and robust security practices. Our system is constantly evolving with new technologies and the job may require learning new skills and industry practices as new computing resources are adopted.

Responsibilities

• Collaborate with developers, operations teams, and security experts to identify and implement best practices for secure, reliable, and scalable cloud-based solutions.
• Implement security best practices across systems, networks, and applications to safeguard sensitive data and maintain compliance.
• Maintain documentation related to infrastructure architecture, deployment processes, and standard operating procedures.
• Proactively monitor and troubleshoot infrastructure issues, ensuring minimal downtime and quick resolution of problems.
• Stay up-to-date with industry trends and emerging technologies, sharing insights and knowledge within the team.

Skills & Experience

• 2+ years in a DevOps or Infrastructure role, showcasing hands-on experience with designing and managing complex IT systems.
• Proficiency in cloud platforms (e.g. Azure) and containerization technologies (e.g. Kubernetes).
• Expertise in Git and MS DevOps, specifically in designing and managing efficient CI/CD pipelines.
• Familiarity with security protocols, compliance standards, and security assessment frameworks.
• Strong problem-solving skills with a proactive and collaborative approach.
• Excellent communication skills and ability to work effectively within cross-functional teams.

Total Benefits

Our belief in promoting a healthy work-life balance drives us to support our employees total well-being, offering comprehensive benefits not limited to:

• We offer competitive pay and benefits to employees.
• Health Insurance.
• Working Schedule: Fridays reduced hours as well as August.

More About Us

We are an equal opportunity employer and ensure that no applicant is subject to less favorable treatment on the grounds of gender, gender identity, marital status, race, colour, nationality, ethnicity, age, sexual orientation, socio-economic, responsibilities for dependants, physical or mental disability. Any hiring decision are made based on skills, qualifications and experiences.

We measure our success as a business, not only by delivering great products and services and continually increasing our assets under administration and market share, but also by how we positively impact people, society and the planet.

For more information on our commitment to Corporate Social Responsibility (CSR) please visithttps://theapexgroup.com/csr-policy/

Click the Apply button and complete the online application process. A member of our fabulous recruiting team will then review your application and follow up with you if you seem like a great fit for this role

Apex ESG Advantage is one of the fastest growing ESG and sustainability firms in Europe, experiencing solid growth over the past 24 months. Our team consists of approximately 150 people from various backgrounds across Amsterdam, London, New York, Valencia and Mumbai all driven by the ambition to make a real impact.

Launched in 2021, Apex ESG Advantage is a business-to-business (b2b) software as a Service (SaaS) platform that allows companies to track their ESG performance and benchmark it against their peers and industry best practices. Specifically designed for the private equity market, it provides investors and fund managers with a holistic overview of the performance of their portfolio... companies.

The role

As a DevOps and Infrastructure Administrator, you will play a pivotal role in designing, implementing, and maintaining our cloud-based infrastructure, while ensuring seamless CI/CD pipelines and robust security practices. Our system is constantly evolving with new technologies and the job may require learning new skills and industry practices as new computing resources are adopted.

Responsibilities

• Collaborate with developers, operations teams, and security experts to identify and implement best practices for secure, reliable, and scalable cloud-based solutions.
• Implement security best practices across systems, networks, and applications to safeguard sensitive data and maintain compliance.
• Maintain documentation related to infrastructure architecture, deployment processes, and standard operating procedures.
• Proactively monitor and troubleshoot infrastructure issues, ensuring minimal downtime and quick resolution of problems.
• Stay up-to-date with industry trends and emerging technologies, sharing insights and knowledge within the team.

Skills & Experience

• 2+ years in a DevOps or Infrastructure role, showcasing hands-on experience with designing and managing complex IT systems.
• Proficiency in cloud platforms (e.g. Azure) and containerization technologies (e.g. Kubernetes).
• Expertise in Git and MS DevOps, specifically in designing and managing efficient CI/CD pipelines.
• Familiarity with security protocols, compliance standards, and security assessment frameworks.
• Strong problem-solving skills with a proactive and collaborative approach.
• Excellent communication skills and ability to work effectively within cross-functional teams.

Total Benefits

Our belief in promoting a healthy work-life balance drives us to support our employees total well-being, offering comprehensive benefits not limited to:

• We offer competitive pay and benefits to employees.
• Health Insurance.
• Working Schedule: Fridays reduced hours as well as August.

More About Us

We are an equal opportunity employer and ensure that no applicant is subject to less favorable treatment on the grounds of gender, gender identity, marital status, race, colour, nationality, ethnicity, age, sexual orientation, socio-economic, responsibilities for dependants, physical or mental disability. Any hiring decision are made based on skills, qualifications and experiences.

We measure our success as a business, not only by delivering great products and services and continually increasing our assets under administration and market share, but also by how we positively impact people, society and the planet.

For more information on our commitment to Corporate Social Responsibility (CSR) please visithttps://theapexgroup.com/csr-policy/

jobs_results.title: DevOps Engineer - Artificial Intelligence
jobs_results.description:
TransPerfect Is More Than Just a Job…
Our greatest asset is our people, and nothing is more important to us than ensuring that everyone knows that. Each of our 90+ offices has its own individual identity, and each also has its own unique rewards.

We’re looking for a DevOps Engineer to join the Artificial Intelligence team at TransPerfect and build services in Golang, NodeJS, Python, C++, and Kubernetes for millions of users.

You’d be part of a team developing our GlobalLink AI suite, that includes a web portal, APIs, and a scalable artificial intelligence platform based on microservices for which we use a state-of-the-art tech stack, including Kubernetes and Docker containers. Your goal will be to improve our CD/CI approach, automate the operations, and enable the platform to exponentially scale.

You’ll fit within our team if you love solving challenges, you want to make an impact working for the top brands in the world, and you are ambitious and detail oriented. You’ll need to... work with a variety of teams in the US, Europe, and Asia, and make things better every day.

To find out more about our solutions, please visit: https://globallink.transperfect.com/

Responsibilities:
• Contribute to the design and operations of our cloud infrastructure (dev, production, QA) in Amazon Web Services and our colocation.
• Run applications on an orchestration platform using tools like Kubernetes, Clipper, and Docker to ensure at least a 99.5% availability.
• Ensure appropriate monitoring and logging, as well as create the right tools for developers to own their pieces of the code with the most autonomy.

Skills and Experience:
• Experience with at least two of the programming languages above and also bash in Linux environments.
• Experience on Kubernetes, Docker, monitoring tools, and CD/CI.
• Good knowledge of AWS.
• Can-do attitude to communicate within a diverse team of developers.
• Previous experience with high-load web applications
